reviews.t: Avoid this app if you want to learn. The content is "user generated", which means it is filled with very bad errors. The other users are supposed to fix it up. What this all means in practice is that you can't trust any of it, and will often be learning bad definitions of words. This is true of the paid version as well as the free. A lot of effort has gone into the graphics and they are great! But a friendly little elephant wandering around in the app is no substitute for accuracy.

Downloaded this app for the flashcards to help with a Japanese class I'm already taking. It only let me have about 8 cards before it made me review. For my class, I have to learn 10 at a time. It makes you do a tutorial and there is no way to disable it. Gave up after about 5 minutes because I could not see it going well in the future, when I have to learn all 45 starting letters.

This app is HORRIBLY disappointing, You honestly couldn't pay me to use it. Its user unfriendly and makes you jump through unnecessary hoops to learn words. Flash cards are supposed to be simple, especially for beginners. There was so much potential here, lost. Im deleting this app.

I used this for Estonian. Maybe if you use this for a more popular language you'd be happier. The translations were clearly done by machine. Many are wrong or in random cases that aren't nominative (e.g. 'market' is given as 'turul' in the addessive case (at the market) instead of turu the nominative.) The pictures are nice for creating your own, but the limit for free accounts is so few I'd rather use another app. The video translation to cards is a nice future but bad translations.

Returning to this app after a couple years because I remember it being useful. However, looks like more features have been locked behind Premium, which is fine! Developers need to be paid! But the price is $65/yr, on sale... apparently $108 normally. That's *insane*. In what world is a flashcard app, no matter how good, worth nearly double the annual price of Duolingo? Until this comes down to a price that isn't absurd, I'll be using Anki.

Meh. While the functions are nice for language learning, the free version annoyances of advertisements, along with the limitations of a maximum of 20 cards, AND only being able to add 20 cards in a day, AND only having one deck available is just too much aggravation. Especially when the pricing structure is a subscription instead of a purchase.

The app has a great concept, except when it falls apart. I love that after adding a word, it suggests a sentence to add onto the flashcard to learn. What makes no sense it why it blocks me from adding flashcards unless I pay for the subscription. This app is supposed to help me learn, not limit my learning. Downloaded Anki and it's 1000X better and you don't get stuck behind a paywall.

Free experience makes the app ridiculously obtuse to beginners. App has cool features that would serve someone who was intermediate but it can't even do a full deck of Hiragana/Katakana with the twenty card limit. Yet it's constantly throwing hiragana/Katakana/Kanji at me and expecting me to somehow understand. I might return when I get better but as a beginner I have to stick to something that can teach me the basics. I'd subscribe to remove the card limit but I doubt it would help.

One of the most annoying language apps I've tried. I wanted the freedom to learn and practice at my own pace in my own way, but this app doesn't let you do that. It forces you to jump between activities and won't let you just focus on one exercise long enough. I don't like being forced into what activities I have to do. They have great tools. It's a shame that they don't give you the freedom to use those tools however you want.

The concept is good. However, I have chosen the german language, the "hard" deck of cards, and there are no articles for substantives, the verbs are not written in the infinitive form, translations are poor in some cases, and sometimes the example sentences have nothing to do with the word given. As a free app is ok, I wouldn't pay for it, given that it needs improvement. The AI feature is pretty useless.

Possibly the most annoying app I have ever bought. I am a B2 level Spanish speaker and I bought the app as an alternative to paper flashcards. I input 40 verbs to learn, but after four or five, the app takes me to a different screen. Pop ups leap out continuously, completely unrelated to what I want to do. If I pay £35 for an app I should be able to use it as I want, not as the app wants. It is very frustrating, I wanted simple, I got annoying. Sorry, not good enough.

Learning Chinese: many words would not come with the correct pinying. The new features for practicing are quite useless and not interactive. The AI powered chat cannot provide more than simple explanations, it's quite useless to chat with. Awful use of deceptive patterns to renew the subscription, not even sending a reminder + they use a 3rd party to charge you, avoiding the payment through Google Play, and therefore, you cannot even try to get a refund after they charge you.

In theory this approach would be an excellent addition to Duolingo to assist the learning experience. However, due to the continuous interruption and push to buy the premium package I uninstalled the app before I had even managed to get familiar with how it works. Every time I tried to follow some 'how to', up came the sales package as it did at every other opportunity it could, completely preventing any cohesive learning. Disappointing!

Really quite an annoying app for learning. If you select a level there seems to be no way to go back and it's the same for once you select a phrase to 'save', if you didn't mean to select it, you can't go back. It seems like they're trying the forcing someone to do something tack that some games use as a training level but it just doesn't seem to have been implemented will in this instance. I might try this one more time but I think it's going to be uninstalled.

it's a really good app for learning vocabulary. And the process for adding words is great. However, it has been really really slow lately. Right now kind of unusable because of the audio delay. It seems to get the audio for the words from the internet. Doesn't matter how fast your internet is, seems to be an issue with their servers. All I know is it's too damn slow.

Won't show enough cards after a while. I'm using a fully paid version and have over 600 cards added. This is NOT about the demo version's 20 card limit. The app "thinks" I have already learned those cards and won't show them again. But that's not the case because I have forgotten a big part of them since I saw them last time a few months ago! I don't want to add even more cards! I want to really learn the current ones!

The free version of the app is very limited and annoying with suggestions to buy a premium. I want to buy but I cannot, because I have troubles with my Google payment profile. I asked a support to help me. It's ridiculous, I want to give my money but nobody wants to take them. What is the problem to integrate any payment service that accepts credit cards in addition to Google play?

I'm a paid subscriber and I was really enjoying this app. But after the latest update it got much worse. You mostly get the most recent words and phrases that you learned, unlike previously when older phrases kept popping up. I get a notification that I got 123 cards to review, and the app offers me about 8. It's a huge downgrade, and I'm cancelling my subscription if they don't fix this. (Plus, the streak reezes that they introduced simply don't work.)

Please do something with the app. It doesn't work too often. Sometimes it starts working after a few minutes. Sometime cards are lagging or skipping by itself. Again couldn't connect 5 minutes ago. And in Chrome on PC can't select text on the cards to translate, because in this case card is immediately swipes left or right side.

Decent content quality, but too much time is spent interacting with app setup and "game features". Flash cards are not well-suited to immersive apps, imo, which they are trying to make this thing. I don't want to pick cards, I don't want to personalise it myself. I want the app to throw some text in front of me, use AI to assess my needs, and show cards. Nowhere near convenient or quick enough to be truly useful. Big pass on this one, maybe my memory is just better than most.

I was very happy with the app because I use it to learn Chinese, but in the most recent update they removed the pinyin section, which was a huge help for knowing how to pronounce or write words if you're new to the language. The loss is very noticeable, and I'm thinking of switching apps since that feature gave this app a significant advantage over others.

I had high hopes for this app, but here's some problems that lead to me uninstalling. 1, I can't learn at my own pace. The app forces me to go over words before I can add more to my deck. It won't even let me watch videos. 2, there was no test or option to pick what level of Spanish one is at, and so it thinks I can only handle a few words at a time. I prefer learning at least 20 new words a day... Not 5. 3, no offline mode yet 4, no option for Latin American Spanish

I used to learn Polish with this app. It had some ads but it wasn't as invasive as right now. Also the prices for the premium went twofold. What used to be 200 UAH a yeah(which was very generous), now is 400,and judging that it's a sale for Ukrainian users, the full price for other regions is 40 bucks for, essentially, a card app. It's still cheaper than most personal tutors, but for the functionality, it's not worth it. I'm leaving a 2 star because it used to be amazing, but it got worse.

Potentially great but... Great concept and execution for digital flash cards, but the constant reminders to buy a subscription is super annoying 😑. Also the price is steep for what it is. Now, I would buy the app if the yearly subscription was just a lifetime purchase of the app but they don't that option.

I purchased a subscription. At the beginning it was ok, but there is some problem with sound. Firstly, after starting to learn the words with cards some words pronounced precipitously Now in addition to it during the learning process the sound disappears and I don't hear pronunciation. Please, fix it

Extremely confusing navigation. Time that I could use for progressing in learning, I end up wasting chasing different sections, but in a very chaotic way. It's not user-friendly, at least not neurotypical user-friendly. Some sections pop up, but then there seems to be no clear navigation principle. Been using for months and still not clearer. The most confusing user end up in a while. It's deflating and off-putting. Will uninstall. Too complicated yet translating on very little outcome.

You advertise this app as a learning from tv series and then there're no tv series in it. I would buy a subscription for Friends or HIMYM in European Portuguese inside, but not for a couple of YouTube videos. And the app actually... doesn't make a difference? It's both Brazilian and European? come on. AI has only 10 free lines.

The app is decent and has a lot of potential, but it would be more useful if it allowed adding cards from other apps, similar to Google Translate's word selection feature. Furthermore, it should offer same-language cards for advanced speakers, where both the word and definition are in the same language.

The app is great but it has a major flaw which keeps me from subscribing. It does not have the option to choose how well you know a word and when it will appear again. It uses instead its own algorithn which "guesses" when it is ok to show a card again. This algorithm is really bad and it does not reflect how well i know a word and when should it should be shown again. I get that they want to make the app friendly and easy to use BUT they should allow to turn on/off this "anki mode" setting

trying to learn Japanese and it's asking me, at very beginner level to look at ENGLISH and decide what the Japanese word is, because right, I have a clue... no, I'll stick with better products that aren't just pulling random words and expecting you to grade yourself, but actually test knowledge... 5 minutes of use sickened me.

The free version of the app is incredibly limited. Now that you can only earn 20 flames a day, it's practically useless for me. I don't think I've ever seen ads so frequent in a mobile app. It's unbearable and I feel like it keeps getting worse the more I use it. The idea is good but there are major flaws.

Interesting concept but despite paying the full version, a lot off issues with the Thai language: romanisation is wrong, pronunciation is too fast and sometimes different, there is no possibility to slow down the speach that seems too automatic and not fluent.

Good UI but the learning exercises don't make sense! I am trying to learn Punjabi and chose family and other basic categories, I get random words or phrases or verbs. Also would be really helpful to have it written in NON native language which I obviously can't read if I'm learning the language. I don't often understand what I'm hearing and the word is in another script. Confusing

It would probably be more accurate to call it Google Translate Cards. The UI is ok. The ads are obnoxious. I think it would be worth using if the incorrect translations were fixed, but I doubt that will happen because Duolingo also has basic issues that haven't been fixed over the years.

Slow animations you can't skip. You get given an English word and have to think of the one in the other language, not the other way around oddly. Anytime you try to go back it just exits the app. Good concept but poor execution.

This is one of the most frustrating apps - it's basically forces you through a ridiculously long guided set up and forces you to add words from groups that don't fit to finish it. Its like being forced to setup what you don't want.

Still trying to get it to work. Developer refunded my family subscription to Play Store but I have yet to receive anything. Zero Zippo Nada. If I ever get a working app, I'll let you know if I think it's any good. I've heard such good things about it. And if Duocards is related to Duolingo, I like that app and am on the second year of a family subscription. serious student.

- Great app in theory - regularly unintuitive or clumsy (e.g. cannot change allocation in library) - no offline mode for learning e.g. on planes or other offline areas - regular errors "our development team will look at it", but no reasoning. - subscription is rather pricey I do expect more convenience

In the beginning loved the app, but I wish the cards were more organized from useful to least useful. Like a group of the 500 most popular words, then the next 500 most popular and so on. I don't know basic Spanish but now I know estribor means starboard. Going to switch to a different app. Lowered to two stars after receiving form response to my three star review.
The app is pretty good in itself. I'm leaving a low score because the price increases drasticly after the first year. After creating thousands of cards and having no way to export the I feel trapped.

Would be great if it didn't force you to do the stupid self-scoring thing. If I could type the answer and be marked right or wrong, this app would get a high score. I'm talking about the showing you a flashcard and asking "do you remember this" and you have to answer yes/no.

The app offers generally good UX for learning flashcards in a modern way. However it has problems that made it unusable. Biggest problem is that the audio is crackling on the latest android version. Might be Android bug, but devs have shown no interest to attempt a fix despite sending video. Also the loading screen takes ages to load, and worse, loads twice each time you open the app. Frustrating, when you just want to get in to learn. Reluctantly ended my paid sub as no fixes forthcoming.

I paid for the premium version. A few days later, it says I'm not subscribed and the money was reimbursed. I'd been using the premium version for a few days so it doesn't make sens. Now I had to pay again, but I still didn't get the money back from the first subscription.

wayyy too complicated. the forced tutorial setup was very involved. all the features might be useful but the barrier to entry was really high. if you want a lightweight flash cards app this ain't it. i miss tinycards. just get Anki.

This so has some serious translation mistakes in the training material. For instance saying “nog“ means "yet". Het meisje is nog een baby. - The girl is yet a baby. I have reported it multiple times and it didn't get fixed.
Simply awful. To much effort required to load up words to learn, I expected that there would be a pre-built set. In addition, the gamification (sic) aspect of the app is annoyingly puerile.

there's a bug in your app that will ultimately make me leave this app for good. the green pointing finger keeps popping everywhere and it won't disappear. it doesn't even show anything, it just messes up the experience. it's not accurate, not helpful and even if it was meant to point out something, it has no point at all. it feels like a glitch or simply a splinter in the eye
I tried this for Albanian and the pronunciation is wrong, and sometimes the words are written incorrectly as well. I would not recommend. Maybe if you stick to popular languages could be good.

I'm using this app for around two months. It is a good app for learning new words. But the problem is the connection error. Almost every time of using it I received this error. I also sent emails to the developers, but unfortunately no answer yet!

Most disappointing language app. l have ever tried.I paid for this app on the back of my subscription to duolingo and expected something of the same quality.Nothing like it.Massively disappointing.I have no problem with repetition but only to a point.This is a one dimensional, uninspired app.I keep returning to it in the hope it has improved but it never does.I have wasted my money on this, doesn't work for me at all.Got memrise instead, a 1000 times better at same price

Helpful tool but shifty payment options. It's helpful for making cards quickly, haven't used much for reading/videos b/c of trial limits. I decided to pull the trigger & subscribe but payment through the app with Google app store won't go through. Contacted customer svc, they told me to use their website instead. I didn't feel comfortable & kept trying but payment never worked. I remembered that I referred a friend, walked them through all the steps & never got credit for the referral either.

Great flash card app I really like how they work and how easy it is to add cards. However, the free card limit made me immediately Uninstaller and look into a different app. I just want to have my flash cards on the go, and I dont have enough money for chicken nuggets so I absolutely will not be paying for this. It would be one thing if it was a one time flat rate but im not doing a subscription service.

App experience was really poor so deleted after 5 minutes. I just wanted to watch a video with translations, but never even got that far because I had to go through tutorials, say no to upgrading a few times, make some flash card deck, review all the words, then the elephant started complaining about finding some flames or cave or something for some quest I had to do, and at that point I just gave up. Just give me the learning content you advertised and don't block me from watching a video.

It seems promising but as I was answering questions to set up my account, I noticed it didn't specify which form of Português to choose, European or Brazilian. It was only after I finished, rejected the option to subscribe, and was about to start my first beginner lesson that it specified it was Brazilian Português. I need European, so I will move on. I'm glad I didn't subscribe before finding out.

Overall, I like how easy this app is to use, but I think I was too quick to spend money on it. Actually studying with it isn't very nice. I'm constantly having to turn the sound and romanisation on and off so I don't cheat myself and it's really frustrating. Also, you can mass important cards, but then it's gives them to you all at once instead of spreading them out. If a way to toggle the sound and romanization for the back and front of cards is added then I would give it a higher rating.

I wish I could give this app a higher rating, it really is great; but the free experience shows you an ad and then ends the ad with a pop-up that basically says "aren't ads annoying? You should switch to premium by clicking here." It feels redundant to give me an ad and then advertise yourself after the ad. Just pick one. It makes one ad break close to an unskippable thirty seconds long because of this

Huge number of cards from and it paces you to move on to new sections once you're comfortable with what you've covered. (Edit): This was previously 5 stars, but some cards have the first sound of a word's audio cutout. I contacted customer service with a video and they gaslit me by saying the video doesn't show what it clearly shows) it's not constant or on all cards so it's manageable but I will keep this at 3 stars until it's fixed.

The app is solid. There are a lot of flashcard apps out there and the only thing I see that this one adds is the ability to make news cards by copying text and using Android's share feature to share the text with the app. Other than that it's your typical flashcard app. The ads are frequent but I don't find them irritating. Unfortunately the only way to go adfree is to pay a subscription, which I refuse to do. I'm willing to make a one time payment but not monthly payments.
I wish you would spend less time with annoying floating elephants and fix your atrocious pronunciations.

I am close to regretting the one year subscription.. The app is basically good, but it is ridiculous that the import of my English -Hungarian own words list takes ages, since You can only import 20 lines at a time! Furthermore it is not possible to add a set of cards with one click, first You have to review all the cards one by one! Tremendous time waster. The words list in the library should be more structured to find the one material You're after. TOEFL/Oxford words list not really to find

The plus points for me are as per other reviews. There are some weird quirks however, due to the AI model presumably. Chats frequently make no sense, such as this example emergency situation: "Thank you for the information. Does the person have difficulty breathing? They like to eat apples". There are frequent random sentences, as well as a fixation on mentioning happy animals in the context of discussing a hotel booking, or constantly asking if I like to wash my hands! That needs a fix.

The app is really good in my opinion. I love using the flashcards and I actually get excited to go on this app every day. But there are so many unnecessary ads to get the premium version if you dont already, and its frustrating when it takes me completely out of my learning state. I also dislike the way you can only study a certain amount per day. This is not needed for an app literally made for studying, and without these flaws this app would be 5 stars. Not the best option, but not the worst.

Helpful way to enrich one's vocabulary. A few issues: a loud sound comes out of the speaker sometimes when swiping cards; when words are saved from an AI-generated story or other material, the example sentence provided when studying the term later on is often incomplete and sometimes doesn't make sense; the pronunciation is incorrect in some cases. Regardless, a good hands-on complementary tool for language learning. Beware: wild email spam (1 per hour) but unsubscribing seems to have worked.

The best app I have found for pure spaced repetition vocabulary learning. Unfortunately, the AI gives glaringly incorrect explanations at least in my first language (Hungarian). I put in some suggestions to fix mistakes but there are a lot of them and frankly, I'm not paying for the privilege to work for the developers. I wish it wasn't in the app, it does more harm than good to people who don't already have a solid foundation in the language they're learning.

Ads are too frequent in a free version. In fact, it has so much potential with AI, but you're not really delivering or even promoting it. Strikes are a joke. When you skip a day, it says 1000+ 🔥 is needed to restore the sequence. But the daily limit is 30 🔥. Search is not working either. Even when you use the exact name for the cards list, nothing is found. I'd like to add/learn words, not open random collections.

This app would have been a clear five-star one, weren't it for the fact that it doesn't really realize its potential (I'm a subscriber). AI coupled with flashcards is a powerful combination, but grammar explanations all look the same (they should be more varied and complete) and examples are often repeating. The Listen feature is very powerful, but we should be able to filter by set of cards. This together with a better production of examples would be great. Looking forward to updates.

Many languages as the native language option👌 (specifically persian), would be a lot better if the app could work completely on the target language; you could learn and practice English words based on English definition and synonyms (the translation would be hidden or sth). Moreover, it would be a lot better if we could see the definition or synonyms of the chosen word in the target language(English for example) while watching videos. Wish we could change the limit for adding words at one go.

I just wanted a simple vocabulary trainer with predefined cards and found it here! One drawback is the card quality, at least for spanish from english. They are often written in different styles like with or without "to/the" so you don't know if it is asking for a verb or noun. And some cards are pretty weird or simply wrong/nonsense.

The app is great except for the videos side, I get that you're trying to make your money with ads, but I can't even get through one minute of a video without the app shoving two unskippable ads in my face, I get one, 2, 3 ads a video, but 2 ads in a minute for 7 minutes straight is insane. If I dare try to select words from the transcript as to check their meaning, I'm sent to the shadow ads realm and I'm never finishing the damn video. Relax with the ads please.
there's no option where to change don't size, and why the sentence with the word are so small?

Really cool... Browser extension should be smarter, but the app itself is very convenient. But downgraded from 5 to 3 stars because of the awful built-in translator. Why don't just use at least Google or rather AI? I study Czech in Russian, and it is impossible. It translates werbs as nouns, also, all translation seems goes to English first, than converted to my preferred language, and it's inappropriate, cuz result is wrong in 30% cases or even more. And don't forget werbs...

Too much gamification for me. It's incredibly distracting. I cannot just skip some things and proceed in my own tempo. Feel forced to do a lot of unrelated staff to my learning process. Concept is great, I like the option with topics to read or videos to watch which are correspondent to your level. Really, I'm avoiding to even open application because I'm bombarded with "game" related things which I cannot just close and proceed, and I payed for a full version!

Looks like the app is still on development. If someone doesn't know basics in Norwegian there is a lot of mistakes with translation, norwegian words etc.. Sometimes I have to check it with explanation and then change translation of the word or even use different app to correct. App has potential but for now you must be careful with learning...

I am still testing it out but it has the usual high price for zero ads, daily learning camp fire limit, and request for information to personalize ads. But I do like the flashcards. Sure, I can make my own, but it takes more time, and these have audio. So 3 starts for now. If you need to play and ad, play one. Do I need the every 2min spam telling me to upgrade?

It's good but could be much better. The intreface is usable once you understand how to navigate it and avoid the useless cartoonish gamification. Some cards' audio is mistaken and there's no way to fix it or report it The example phrases are not suitable for beginners and are often uncomprehensible. The way cards are repeated is pretty good and helps you memorize better.
I would love to watch some ads to get access to the premium part. Now as it is useless for me since everything is blocked from, after using for one week and not able to buy full subscription.

In common I am really satisfied with the app and would like to rate with more than three stars. Unfortunatly even premium does not change that the connection to the Server is very unstable. Multiple times a day I am not able to practice 'cause of the missing connection. I will rate 5 Stars if the problems are going to be fixed.

It's quite buggy. Even when I spell the word correctly, it often says I haven't. I thought it was case sensitive (which is in itself silly) but it's still saying I've written it incorrectly even when I account for that. Also it's quite laggy, only by a few milliseconds but the overall feel is quite frustrating to use.

Bit too basic and overly structured for an intermediate learner looking to increase my vocab and train my ear. The feature that lets you save words and phrases gained from video learning is a good idea, but the translations are too literal to be very helpful in context. And it's a bit annoying to use, actually.

This app desperately needs an offline mode to be useful. When you do have time to study? When you are on a plane or a train or in a waiting room without internet reception. Well, you can't with this app. It's incredibly frustrating. There should be an option to save the flashcards to phone memory.

This is a great app but a bit difficult to navigate and missing a few features. I wish the app would show an example sentence by default instead of having to modify the card to add it, and also read the sentence when doing audible training. I also wish there was an easier way to retest learned words more often. And, as others have said, accuracy is a bit lacking. Last, I wish I could study offline. I fly a lot and would like to study on the plane. It seems silly to need an Internet connection.

I know the basics of spanish but I really wanted to expand my vocabulary, especially since I work with someone from Venezuela who speaks very little English. This app has been working really well for me so far. You can pick what words you want to study from diffrent pre made sets. The only down side is that you can't make your own set to learn from without paying. Well, you can, but theres a low limit to how many cards you can "learn" at a time and you can't add more or make a set to use later.

(Edit from previous 3-star review) Initially the app does not give you an option to not make an account, but after backing out over and over I was finally able to proceed without one. There is also a free version, but the option is small, remote, and difficult to find at first glance. The flashcards seem good (I say this as a former professional linguist), but the app's gentle coercion into starting a pro trial and minimizing of free options prevents a five star rating.

I speak Spanish fairly well but I need practice. What I lack is vocabulary, and this app fits that need perfectly! I wouldn't recommend this to very new learners, unless it is used with other learning materials as it doesn't teach any grammer. I have also found a few incorrect translations when I searched for verbs outside of a sentence but it does well if you search a full sentence with the same verb in it. I would give 5 stars if they can fix that issue as I am trying to drill mostly on verbs.

Exactly what I needed. Edit: I stand by this being an excellent tool for language learning, especially when paired with e-books, but there are some issues to be aware of. Adding words automatically from your browser is incredible but sometimes the translation is just wrong so keep an eye out. Once translation is a little more accurate ill take this up to 5.

First day of use. Intuitive, pleasing easy load smooth graphics. A few too many ads per use ( still on freemium) . Love the pick your own vocab model ! The articles for reading comprehension are exactly what I need. Looking forward to trying out the gamification rewards for motivation. I hope future updates will test pronunciation and offer options for type of Spanish, ie. Purto Rican, Castilian, Filipino and regional colloquialisms. I will rate again after subscription.

Good app with noticeable problems. I don't use the flashcards, I do import everything I use (videos and articles). Problems: 1. The translation can be inaccurate and I have to go to another dictionary for the correct translation. 2. There is no way to organize the imports, for example, to put all videos from one youtube channel all together. My sources is merely in order of importing. With more than a couple of imports, it makes it chaotic and somewhat difficult to find anything.

A solid vocabulary builder for foreign languages. The app is really in your face about buying a subscription. Without said subscription, there are lots of useful features, like the "undo" button and the ability to learn more than 2 languages at once, that are locked behind an in-your-face paywall. I would love there to be more functions for free users in this app. And, if there can be an ability to buy a lifetime subscription, I'd consider the investment if the price is good enough.

Really well-designed app. It's exactly what I was looking for to help broaden my Spanish vocabulary. However, the free mode is a little too restrictive. You cannot add ANY more words if you have 20 or more that you are "learning", and the app takes weeks to decide you have learned them, so you get stuck in a bottleneck of practicing words you already know. I get having to make money - but it's also important to have a usable app. I would reccomend changing this setup or at least the word limit.

So far I'm loving the app! The visual design is very simple and cute (you take care of a lil woolly mammoth) and I'm learning a lot. Really my two main issues so far are the insistence on buying a membership and how clunky the matching feature is. The membership advertising is bearable though, so fix the matching game and I'll bump this up to a 5 star!

I think it is a very nice app and well built. It is easy and fun to use. I am a little suspicious about the way some grammar is said to be AI generated as I don't want to learn incorrect stuff and then try to speak it. I'd recommend pairing it with another language learning app or books and using this app mainly for vocal memorization. I actually really love the interface and how encouraging it is which is why I ended up paying for the full version.

I really love the thought put into this app. It's very easy to use and very easy to understand. This tool will be one of the most useful in my collection. The fact that I can go anywhere and click and save a word for later study is awesome. That's one of the best features. The only reason I haven't given 5 stars is because of the ads. I shouldn't have to see so many. I completely understand that it's necessary to keep things free but you still should find a way to lessen them.

hi, thank you for this great app, but it is common that people who want to improve their ability in a new language, try to see meaning of words or desctiptions in same language, for instance if I want to learn English, and not from scratch, then the option to select English as base language can be great. It it possible to have this option?

The only improvements I would suggest are automatic gendering of names (especially in German), and also automatically adding the plural form to names. I would also love to see automatic Partizip 2 added to verbs.

It is a good app. I use it in the free version and I add my own cards. I like that it translates the words and let's you choose an icon. What I don't like is constant interruptions even if you just add the cards. I understand the need to upsale but choosing from 2 options "subscribe" and "i'm not so serious about my learning" is a bit low. If someone doesnt upgrade it doesnt mean they dont care.

I like the app. The AI can be quite useful in explaining vocabulary and giving examples. I find that I often have to choose a better picture than the auto-recommended one.my biggest suggestion is to give more ways to interact with the cards and test my knowledge. It gets really repetitive. Maybe a "choose the correct spelling" or "choose the right word for this sentence". All in all, I'm glad that I paid for the app.

It's really good. I like that there are set packs to learn from & you can add your own words & phrases. I am using the free version. I don't mind the ads since they're for the app itself rather than annoying ads. However, there are a few limitations & things I don't like. Not all word meanings/ or readings are accurate (Japanese). A lot of pictures have nothing to do with the word. I wish they'd increase picture options for manual editing. As it is, it's definitely not worth paying for.

Overall a good app. The only thing is that translations can sometimes be a bit inaccurate or slightly misleading (English -> Hebrew). But outside of that, these things can be overlooked with double checking translations (e.g. pealim). The layout of the app and the use of flashcards and the little mammoth with fire are very motivating features. Learned and known words are also very useful distinctions for the learner. Gentle introductions to "medium" vocabulary is useful too which is good

Edit: Generally a nice flash card app, with some gamification parts. I try to learn portuguese with the app. There is an automatic translation of the words that are enterd, but it is sometimes not accurate and has to be fixed by hand. So far, I did not find an option to tell the program which language it should display on the cards to guess which is a little bit annoying. Otherwise, not bad as a learning supplement.

Right now this is my favourite language-learning app. Unlike Duolingo, you have control over your learning goals, as you can set the words you want to memorize. Request: On word cards, write the type of word (noun, adjective, verb) and have a button to show the conjugations and/or other forms of the word. Also make some features available offline, as this app is going to be frequently used on planes and trains.

Overall a very good app for vocabulary building. The language I'm learning (te reo Māori) unfortunately doesn't have a lot of resources atm (not just in this app, but in general), so I'm using this to create my own cards to learn, and it's great. However, to me it's still missing a few features to make it 5 stars even with a subscription (which I have): 1. Ability to record correct pronounciation for each card. 2. Add custom pictures to cards. The available ones are cute, but not enough.

easy and fun app to use for different learning requirements. you have flash cars but also videos with a script that you can scroll through and read. the only problem I have is there is no way to learn the articles with the nouns, which is such an essential part of German. I hope this gets added in the future, and if that did get sorted, then I would actually put money into the app!

The app has a couple of bugs sometimes, Right now I have a bug when the advice to chat with the mammoth appears, all the app froze. But despite of that, I love all the Features, we can create cards from content that we like, we can import content from YouTube, we can translate sentences, we have grammar explanations, and the quality of the cards is very high. I'm new so I don't know if the spaced repetition system works, but it seems pretty neat! Great App!

Great app for getting an initial grip on a language. Some language packs like Czech or even Scots Gaelic feel very neglected in comparison to languages like Spanish or German, though annoying, and a lack of consistency with the Ai detection of words (I.e words not immediately recognized are auto translated to "Retrieved from" ALWAYS), I still think it's much more worth to sink a premium to this app in comparison to something more mainstream, like, Duolingo.

I really like the DuoCards app, but I have 3 suggestions for improvement. 1) The pronunciation of the word “compulsion” is incorrect, please check 2) It would be great to have different English pronunciation/vocabulary options, as I need Australian English. 3) When tapping a word, the dictionary should allow users to choose between different parts of speech instead of selecting one automatically. Overall, the app has strong potential, and I hope these improvements will be implemented.

Great app! I would be learning new language this fast without it. AI is misleading sometimes, always check with dictionary. It doesn't correct you if you have typo. I miss having an option to practice specific deck anytime. You can do that, but only after you review all the cards in 'to learn'. If I were to go to an exam and I would need to learn just that specific deck, I would still need to spend time learning words, that I don't need for the exam. If there is an option, I haven't found it.

Didn't you think about adding some sort of feature to add new cards into vocabulary automatically or at least remind the user to do so. Cause now I'm learning Spanish, that I don't now any at all and it doesn't really matter to me which words to learn as long as they are relatively common. So it would be cool to do add something like the forth column of cards, lets call it "planning to learn" that the program is going to use when my short term memory would become empty.

I rate the flow efficient. The app is designed stylish. The only thing I couldn't find without searching for it is a dark theme. It's just that I don't like ads, why I have to abandon ship. Besides that, as a believer that commercials should be a program, which you can opt-in at your disgression-- without any restitution - I wouldn't mind buying modules in the application when prices are affordable. Ads, really don't sell me. Ads are a sign of an oppressed society. Oppressing is bad,mojo. XX

This app definitely has potential. I've recommended it to others. But here's why I wouldn't give it five stars (for now): 1) The translations can sometimes be inaccurate. Their AI is not yet on par with, say, chatGPT or Gemini, so I'm finding myself sometimes fixing them with these and importing them here. 2) The listening mode would be awesome if it wasn't so laggy. Sometimes it stops by itself or takes forever to load. It doesn't count as practice either. An offline mode would be a plus.

For me, it's pretty-hard to learn new language when I already knew 300 words, to continue learning just by cuts of phrases without variations. You suppose to buy full version; ok, when I just will be able to do this — do you agree that if I won't like it, I will rate it lower? (I also used another app to learn Chinese; and that was more easier and interesting then learning languages via this app, unfortunately, almost all languages to choose though).

So far this app is pretty good. You can practice spacing reading and writing, and the spaces repetition is quite good at predicting when you are about to forget a word or sentence. It can be a bit annoying when you are trying to speak, and it cuts you off with the answer though. I would appreciate a little more time to answer, especially for the longer phrases. The ai voices can also be hit or miss depending on the language. Korean sounds okay for the most part, but Thai tones aren't fantastic.

Very useful and it's an easy way of learning. I am happy with the app after trying a few. It's great that there are courses and videos from which you can add the words you want to learn. And that you can ask and learn about the grammar too. What I found though quite annoying, is the default button to generate a story. It always generates a fairy tale..... I would love to have a button with which I won't read about golden treasures with magic spells in it, but sometimes more realistic.

I'm giving 4/5 because it has been annoying me that when I change a detail on an existing card from its set, the change does not apply on the card that is already in the learning process, same the other way around : it creates 2 versions of the same card. Hate this. Other than that I love this app, it is a very good tool to learning but I think it should be used along with another app/website to learn a language. Also you have to learn how to use it and make your own content (sets of cards) .

Would be perfect if... - it also displayed a random example under the word without the need for opening the definition page. - it didn't screw up my streaks. If I open the app to practice when I have time, that doesn't get registered and added to my streak. I'd need to wait for the push notification to be able to tick the day.

the learning experience is great! as is the gamification. the app however needs to be restarted each time you 'minimize' it and I wasn't able to buy a subscription because the account authentication part is buggy. I'll recommend it anyway though, I've only had it for a week and I've already spent hours on it.

The last update is great. I had been waiting for a long time when I can see learning word inside it's example on card. If you: 1. add sintax to make words bold, italic, colored 2. add a setting enable/disable pronouns text in brackets 3. add tools to show endings for plural form of German words. 4. Export your learning words (I want then use them with chatGPT) - I'll be happy.
Very good app. Just some small problems. Overall, it's great.

It's a really great app for learning new words, actually IMHO it's the best flash cards app from learning view, but I would like that an app have some base word sets like ngsl or oxfrod dictionaries by default, so I can count my progress more accurate and understand what else should I learn. Also these default sets should be officially added and moderate by Duocards, so we can be sure it's official. Like e.g. creating 3000 flash cards one by one by myself from ngsl list it's not for me.

Cool app to learn words. It's easy to use and contains many features. But if you don't have a subscription, you're limited too much. You're literally limited on 30 words per day. It would be okay if it was 30 NEW words per day, but you can't even practice them after reaching 30 "flames". Ad frequency is low here (1 or 2 ads every 5 min),but when you discover free version limits, ads become inappropriate. In general it is a qualitative app, but it would be better if practising was unlimited.

I just installed the app today, and I'm really content with it, there's just little errors while using the app, first: pictures are not being loaded for me, and second: I have to use vpn to open the app. Maybe these errors occur to all Iranian users like me. Still thanks for helping us learn different languages. I love how the app allows us to add new words or how it repeats the unlearned words all for free♡ great job!

I very much appreciate this app because it keeps words I'm learning in a handy flash card system and it's easy to add more. The library with well thought out categories of words you can traverse is very handy. Especially the YouTube videos that are fully captioned that you can select from makes me happy. I have ideas for improvement I can share separately with the developer. I was impressed so much on day 1 that I went for the reasonably priced subscription.

Really love this app. I have a few suggestions though: 1. I would paybut I intentionally don't because I think the cap of 20 words is perfect to make sure you're not overwhelmed. Wish this was added to paid version. 2. Wish there was a way to pick multiple meanings for certain words automatically. Or change the meaning to one you want via ai automatically 3. wish there was more flexibility in how quickly cards come back. I currently find the current repetitions too spaced out for me personally

I love this app because it's hassle-free and let's you translate words or phrases in your native tongue while providing synonyms and definitions as well. I can save anything I need on my collections, make my own sets of cards, watch videos in YouTube with subtitles and translations that help more in learning than typical language learning apps. Immersion is by far the most effective strategy in my opinion and this app allows me to do it. It's just lacking offline features with some bugs.

I enjoy the app, I think it's a great way to build foundational vocabulary to help on a language learning journey, my biggest issue is the case sensitive in answering cards. Like if you put "I am" but the card answer has "I'm" you get it wrong. It's a small thing but it can be improved.

Best use of AI for language learning! I wish there were more feautres, for example you could add a new test where a word is given and we picked/ranked words most similar and least similar to it. Perhaps also spelling, commonly confused words, most natural sounding synonyms suiting certain contexts, idioms and phrases, literal vs actual meanings, and even poetry level mastery! I see a lot of potential in this app. Would subscribe for new ideas and features mentioned above. Good job so far!

It is good for memorize words like flash card. Pros App focus the words that you don't know. Cons 1. Searching existing words interface is not good. You push search button and scroll down and click the search box.... It must be like that; click search button and write what you want to search. I need to add notes to existing words. 2. When I added new word, app must be show existing one not to add double or same.. 3. It uses internet to much, there must be local databases

Caution!! The example sentences (German) are sometimes wrong. One needs to double check with dictionary to ensure to use the word in the right way. The translation is also sometimes misleading. Suggestion: improve the quality of translation and example sentences, provide translation and examples based on more trustworthy sources instead of AI.

It's great so far, I even decided to subscribe for a year. What I'm missing is a fast way to add words in bulk - would be amazing to have an integration with camera or text recognition from a screenshot. It will be 6 stars if the developers invest in a UX/UI designer to make the screens more intuitive, I had to close the app to see the name 🤷🏻‍♀️

Good app, but two glaring flaws: first, it needs a more customised way to review previously learned vocab. The way it works now is too inflexible. Second, it *desperately* needs an "offline" mode. I'm going on a cruise in a couple of days, and unless I pay a stupid amount of money for poor satellite connectivity, I can't use DuoCards *at all,* even though I've invested considerable time in building a vocab database that tracks my learning experience to date. Not cool, DuoCards' developers.

The free version good even with the ads. I like how I have the power to choose the level of learning. One thing I dislike on other apps, including the popular ones, is it starts you at the very basic level even if you are halfway fluent. Will rate again if I get the paid version.

Featureful, highly adaptive to personal needs (full control over your flashcards: trash them, skip what you know etc), well integrated auto-translate by arbitrary selection everywhere (not just single words)... You can also jump from learning a flashcard straight into an AI chat about the word! My sole nitpick: it kinda front-loads its entire featureset, which is a bit much for a total newcomer I think. May be nicer to unlock the features (and their tutorials) as the new user gains XP.

This is better than all of the copy & paste language apps that are the same as each other. But you know i hate way y'all give us too few flames that it just ends up right away when i practice some words and to afford more it costs an arm and a leg for so many people i believe. Could be wonderful if its more useful in its flame conditions ..

the feature "Practice/Listen" is very useful, but it stops automatically when the smartphone gets off. I seem to have done the proper setting in the phone to prevent it, but the setting didn't help. The developers pls pay attention to this issue.

I really like this application. I am currently learning Serbian with it and use it everyday. A specific minus of application is associated with exactly Serbian language. It has both Cyrillic and latin alphabets but the application provides sets of cards both on latin and Cyrillic alphabets. And if I type the word correctly but on different alphabet the word turns in red saying me that I guessed the word incorrectly. Will be glad to get that fixed😊😊😊

I love the app. Duo Cards is not aggressive in motivation to learn and offers various ways to learn; by reading, listening or watching. Ads are also of the app itself which is why I bought premium. It would be awesome if Duo Card had a widget for quickly adding words to Duo Cards. I prefer to look up a word on Duo Cards than Google Translate because of the indepth information about the word offered by Duo cards. But it's such a hassle to open app for this.

A really great tool to learn vocabulary of a certain language, in my case trying to learn Arabic. The only annoying thing: When you create a new card, the new word (in Arabic typed in phonetic) gets copied automatically into the proposed translation and first needs to get deleted before being able to capture the correct one. Is there a setting to avoid this unecessary step?

This app could be much better with one crucial feature: the ability to choose which language appears on the front of flashcards. Apps like Anki and RemNote allow this and it makes a huge difference. Learning by translating from your native language forces real recall and understanding. Without this option, the app encourages memorizing answers instead of actually learning the language. Aside from that this is an AMAZIN APP. I would pay for the pro version if they made this suggested update.

Update: docking a star because of the audacity of the new subscription price. It's always been unjustifiably and ridiculously high, but $66/yr is just offensive. It has a very simple design and has no original content. Idk how no one has put up a $10 clone yet, easy money. // As far as flashcards apps go, this is an excellent app. French text can be highlighted from other apps and then phrases added to your deck by conveniently selecting this app from Android's share tray.

This is a great app, and with some improvements to the flashcard section, could be the best language learning app out there! I have the subscription. I wish it included the option to change font size, have a romanization toggle on the card vs for all of them as a whole. The video and article functions are fantastic!!!

I liked this app! I’ve been using the pro version for a few months and noticed one thing I really want to fix. I add new words, but I won’t see them until I’ve learned all the previous ones perfectly. I mean, the words I’m adding to the app today, I’ll see at best in a few weeks. I would like to have an option when all words are shuffling and not go strictly in the order of the addition. thank you very much for your work!

Get this app if you want to use spaced repetition software for language learning without having to spend a lot of time creating your flashcards. Anki is great, it's highly customizable but for me that's also its problem. I found myself spending too much time trying to learn how to use the software and I was overwhelmed by the process of adding new cards, pictures and audio. DuoCards simplifies this so I can actually get to work learning my cards

I like it! The ability to share words to the app to add them to the deck is very convenient and the time between words feels a little better for me than other flash card apps. The use of AI means you sometimes need to make corrections, even in the pre-made decks. Minor issues: 1. Touch sensitivity seems off during matching quizzes, and you have to double-check if it registered. 2. Sometimes a card comes up and is replaced by another card, and it's confusing to know which word I'm answering.

one of the better language vocabulary apps in my opinion. it's helping a lot as a supplement to my minimal schooling. I like that it's simple, no frills, has a clear voice for the language I'm learning which isn't always available, and uses the technique of bringing back words from a while ago (I forget what it's called...). the transliteration is written in like latin pronunciation which throws me off a bit but it's better not to use It anyway. actually considering paying for the premium soon..

Honestly, this is the best flashcard app I've found for Bengali. It has been hard to learn Bengali because there is not a lot of resources available but this app has a simple interface, some readily available material, and it's easy for me to create my own study material from online articles and videos. I also think the algorithm works well for me. It keeps me motivated to see my list of "known" words growing steadily while still reminding me about some of the older words so I don't forget them.

Love the app. They have a large library of different articles you can read in the desired language, and you can translate every individual word and add it to a collection of flash cards to learn from. You learn so much faster it's incredible. I highly highly recommend trying it. And don't use it for a minute and quit, but really try going through the newspapers and teach yourself each word and dig into it. This is the only app that has this feature. We must support this gem.

I love this app. It has really helped me to increase my Spanish vocabulary and listening skills well beyond what I learn with the other popular freebie language app. Both apps, in conjunction, are really a winning combo. You don't have to get the paid version for good features, but for me, it's totally worth it. May 2024 edit.... Ok, so, I didn't think this app could get any better, but it did! Now, in the paid version (which is cheap,) it will tell you stories and quiz you! Amazing! I LOVE it!❤

Excellent app! It's easy to add words, the only couple things that could be improved is that translation to Russian sometimes is not as accurate as Yandex dictionary/other Russian dictionaries, and also pictures that appear above the words don't really relate to the word in any way and appear kind of random, but it's a pleasure to use this app.

DuoCards is a fantastic tool for vocabulary building. It's super easy to add words you want to learn. (Type them in, share them from a web page, find existing lists, etc.) You get instant translations, so no need to look the words up. The algorithm for learning the words is extremely effective. There are options to study smaller lists separately, and other useful tools. I had a few questions about features that weren't clear to me, and I found that user support is fast and super helpful.

After glancing at other reviews I should say I have the paid version. It is very cheap and good value. It sounds like popups make the free version unusable. Easy to use and great for adding vocabulary. I love both the suggested card packs and the ability to add my own words, in either my target or original language. I like that it's not just swiping back and forth, but gives the option to type your guess for the card in, which helps me remember better than just thinking or saying the words.

I've found this app to be tremendously useful for language learning. As a longtime fan of paper flashcards, streamlining and automating that process into an app let me take it to the next level. I started with the free version, but was quickly motivated to go beyond 20 words per day, so I upgraded to the paid version. Some of the best money I've spent this year. I've since added over 2000 words to my vocabulary in German. My biggest complaint is the lack of even limited offline functionality.

Love being able to choose between the different packs, add and edit cards, and love the way the app sorts cards between words you know and words you have to learn. I also love how there is an option to type out the words because I actually typing out the words helps so much with language learning and reinforcement. EDIT: I've been having fun creating my own packs and making them public. It's nice to see that so far they have received 5 stars!

Don't roast this app unfairly, just move your....! There are sets of cards that you can open up and you may add words to your deck or dismiss for you already know them. I add 30 daily for it is the free version limit. I sometimes don't even notice if I know the words. The best part is you can edit the cards! After adding I start reviewing them;if it is new I check the meaning on the internet to double check the meaning, edit it the way I know I'd learn better,etc. I have a lot to say, no space!

I don't usually give out ratings, but man, just get this app. It's: 1.) A true language learning freemium app. Very usable without payment and the "ads" aren't annoying either. If I had the money, I would get it just as a donation to the devs for making such a fine app. 2.) AMAZING for vocabulary, explains words, generates nice icons, allows you to answer by typing out the answer or saying it out (you can also just flip the card) -Include AI feature that accepted nuance (e.g. Es-tu vs. Tu es)

I was looking for a flash card app that I could write words, English on one side, Spanish on the other. This is it, but it's all done for you. Great Flash card app to learn Spanish!!!!!!!! Paid for it, thats how good it is. I don't pay for any apps usually. If you use daily, worth every penny.

Super cute flashcard based app with some gamified features. Plus you can add words to it from your browser when reading articles and it has videos on there where you can watch the videos while it has the words written out and you can add the words you don't know to your flashcard stack. I use this app along with Duolingo, the combination has increased my learning. When I come across a word I struggle with in Duolingo, I add it over to this app and it sticks faster that way.

Clear experience, liked the tutorial, friendly interface. I LOVE that you can add words you find on the web by sharing it to the app. Vocab is grouped by topics w/ levels from beginner to hard. Exactly what I wanted to supplement duolingo. Happy it has Welsh which many apps don't support. Unfortunately I don't think it's showing soft mutation of female nouns after a definite article so I'll need to practice those elsewhere. Would like to have option for with & w/o def article & see gender.

Premium features behind paywall, but the free experience does a great job. The thing I like most about this app (comparing it to others) is that it actually explains the RULES of the language so you can better understand how it actually works. Direct translations and being able to hover and translate a specific word is also a great approach. I use this alongside duolingo and memrise (vocalizing, real convos) and feel like the combo is working faster than a formal class.

I posted a 1 star review a couple of days before because the cards were not working, I can't find my review to change it, but I want to give 5 stars because it is working now. You solved it very fast thanks.

It's the best app for language learning that I've ever seen. The cards are convenient to create and go over. The feature that makes this app unique is a possibility to receive premium features for free by inviting friends. I already have invited 2 my friends and now they also use this app daily. The only thing that I want developers to add is an ability to attach your own images to flashcards (from storage) or to draw pictures just in the app, because sometimes it's hard to find the proper image

This is such a great app. You can add your own vocab, the cards are very easy to make, & you can study from only one card set or from many sets at the same time. You can also add premade illustrations on the cards, which is great. It is repetitive enough but not too much (because it follows the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, so the vocabulary comes back when you start to forget it). I like the gamified aspect & the videos with the subtitles where you can click on a word & add it to ur sets.

Hello, I really enjoy using your app. I have a request. In the practice section, when I do listening exercises, I usually keep seeing the most recent phrases and words I learned. For example, the words and patterns I learned six months ago rarely appear, or appear very little. It would be great if you could add a setting that allows more review of older vocabulary and expressions. Secondly, it would be amazing if the vocabulary flashcards offered a complete course from A1 to C1 in one package.

I have been using this application for years by now. Some of its translations and explanations have needed to be double-checked (my native language is Hungarian), However, I have learned more than 1700 words with this application. Nevertheless, there is still room for improvement. For example: adding spelling tests would be a great idea.

I really like this app to learn works. There are some weak sides, but it seems that they will be corrected or improved. I bought the premium because I wanted more that allowed free version. I am looking forward to implementation suggested by other users. I really would like to get coins for learning words, have an avatator and spend coins to buy clothes or decorate its imaginary house. It will bs nice to make virtual gifts to other users.
Great app for learning languages.

I'm incredibly grateful to the creators of Duocards! Out of all the language-learning apps I've tried, this is the best one. The AI deck generation feature is absolutely amazing! I wanted a quick way to create decks with the phrasal verbs from the book I'm reading, but adding them manually would have taken forever. Then I discovered the AI feature, and it completely blew my mind! 🤯 I love that the developers actually listen to users and keep improving the app. I'll definitely keep using it.

It works pretty well if you have a bit of a background with the grammar of the language you are studying. The downside is that the free version is really limiting you (ads + time limit), so it's hard to see the full potential before buying. And mostly, there is no Lifetime payment option, which for some including myself most of the time, is a big no no. A one time payment with a reasonable price would be worth an instant purchase !

I love the app and the concept, it's very helpful for language retention! The only downside that needs to be worked on is the accuracy of the translation, especially the pictures used as a reference for the translation. Many of the pictures do not accurately reflect the translation. Without context, or sentences some words night be confusing for beginners and misunderstood. Perhaps providing context or sample sentences will be helpful. Other than this I believe the app is perfect!

Amazing app! It's super easy and convenient to add new cards, and images are usually automatically generated to match the meaning of the word. Same for translations. Simply choose a collection of cards to learn from and make it part of your daily routine! Just do a little each day, and you'll be surprised how much you remember. One thing I'd like to have is more grammatical information. It'd be really handy to have gender, tense, aspect, etc, info of a word available when making new cards.

(After two days:) I like it. Has my language (rare), it doesn't restrict free use too much (20 new cards a day) and there are so many options here - so many shows and articles etc that I didn't know of before! A great app to find more resources for your language. With transcripts and help to understand them. I also like that it allows me to add my own cards and that it offers grammar etc tips when struggling with a card. On top of a cute but simple background mascot - definitely a fan so far.

Great way to learn vocabulary through different memory channels! (written, oral, pictures and context). As soon as you enter a new word, it automatically creates a flash card for you with all those elements. The best way to memorize new words! Very friendly and nice app design, fun to use! The best part : the AI language assistant that is like a personal teacher. I'm always asking it to show me the different verb forms, the use of different words or expression, etc. I absolutely love it!

Great app for learning languages, but sometimes it marks correct answers as wrong. For example, I wrote "He is usually on time" and it said it's wrong because it is expected "He's usually on time." Both are correct and mean the same thing. It would be better if the app accepted full forms and contractions equally. Please make the answer checking more flexible. Thanks!

Maybe not such slick design as some of the other language apps, but as a flexible powerful tool for learning vocab and phrases, it beats most of the competition hands down. It's not meant to be a full language course it itself though, for that you want something like Babbel, or just a few textbooks. But it is a really useful tool to use alongside. The paid version is better obviously, but the free version is perfectly usable and shows what you get, so it's worth giving it a shot at least.

I've been using this app for 1 year, and I could say that it's one of the best app for learning new vocabulary in the language you want to learn! These flashcards has spaced repetition, if you want to do your own flashcards you can do it and is easy, since you only have to put the word and the system itself translate it with a sentence below, also you can hear the word that makes your pronunciation better and if you don't have time to make your own flashcards, there are people who shares theirs.

5 stars! I'm using this with Duolingo to learn German. It's very good, even without premium! I like the AI because it can make stories using words you are learning. I personally don't mind the limitations, since I don't use this enough to get more than the max amount of flames (flames are basically just levels that can go down) I also really like the feature that you can add your own cards, and export them from anywhere! I think that this app will help me alot with learning German! 👍🏻

Been a lifesaver this one, for a student like me who has to try and learn C1 level German in a really short time :') especially with vocabulary. Adding verb conjugations would help a lot, and maybe an option to add more than 1 example of sentences to go along with the words. Otherwise it serves its purpose of vocabulary building really well, like a better version of Duolingo. Also, Malmo is absolutely adorable. Thank you for letting us pet him. C:

Great flashcard app! I use it every day at work when I'm not busy. It's great, and it works quite well. I think it uses a great technique for learning. Many of my words I get every time will only show up after a few days or weeks, and it definitely will help to create long-term memory of these words! Highly recommended! There are videos and stories to see and read, and you can pick words or phrases from the scripts and save them as cards! So many resources, will likely be getting Plus soon!

Fixed my rating now that the bug is fixed :) I love the app! The spaced repetition is so useful. I wish words were mixed up a bit more because when I enter two words from the same example, studying the first one automatically makes me know the one that comes right after, even if I wouldn't have remembered it if it was asked first. Plus I eventually just remember the sequence of words in English even if I didn't truly remember the German translation.

The way the app encourages you to build vocab rather than add en masse, is constructive. The ability to give yourself notes, examples of use, grammar etc. is very useful. The free version is worth a try, but you're going to have to pay eventually as the number of words you can practice / add each day is limited. But I'd say it's value for money having tried other apps (Anki, Memorise). I've added 2.5k Italian words over about 8 months, and these are now words I know.

Somewhere between 4 and 5 stars. It's really really nice having in-depth info on (almost) every word/phrase you add. I also enjoy ease with which you can add cards, including your own custom ones. Only downside is that the available premade decks you can add cards from are a bit limited/strange (at least for French).

App is great! Especially for English learning because it offer not only a translation, but also an English description of the particular word and examples how word is used in different situations. But I have some issues when I'm learning Japanese in this app. Sometimes furigana is not right for some kanji, so, I think it would be better if there was an option to edit and write your own furigana to the kanji. And I appreciate if furigana was written on the top of the kanji, not on the bottom.

Great app! The best use of AI I ever saw: it explains the vocab, makes stories with the words you need to study, and an incredibly intelligent system that helps you target your weak vocab. Interactive videos, texts, courses with grammar explanations. Have been using it for over half of the year now and haven't run into a pay wall (except that you can have only two languages at the same time without the premium, but that's fine). The navigation isn't intuitive, but the app has everything you want

This app is great. I have been a paid subscriber for years. It perfectly complements the other tools I am using to learn Spanish. Whenever I encounter a new word or expression, I just add it to my cards, and the app does the rest to make sure I never forget it. Good AI chat feature. July'25 update: the new pronunciation assistant is fantastic. It works really well. Tells you exactly how to improve. Many negative comments here apply to the free version which is quite limited. Subscribe!

The app is great, I just wish the subscription was more affordable or that you could give discounts every now and then, like Duolingo does. If the yearly sub was paid monthly instead of the full price all at once, I would definitely subscribe. Suggestion: it would be nice if we could save the story that the AI creates for us with the words we learned. This would help us to retain the words better, imho. Or a simple copy button would be great, too.

One of the best flashcard apps I've ever used! You can add your own flashcards, organize them into folders, and study them. A very good feature in my opinion is the generation of unique images for each flashcard: it makes it easier to memorize the words. I also like how AI was used in the app: it is a learning support, that suggests pointers on grammar rules and on translations or sentence examples. The streak system, with not just days but also points are rewards is also super motivating

I like the app a lot, it makes it easy to make cards, and the ai is very helpful when you need something explained, although whenever I want to continue from where I left the pop up for it goes away too quickly before I can click yes which is kind of annoying. Maybe having a separate button "continue" because whenever I want to review a lot of the words I have learned I can't do it all in one setting, but it's gone when I go back. please fix it, thank you.

It's just the app I was looking for! Like that I can adjust almost everything: change pics for memo cards, correct translation, choose from several variants an example of using, that pop up automatically, see some grammatical comments. I like the words' sounding here (озвучка), even though it's made with AI, that sounds much better than I've heard in other apps. And lots of videos with subtitles :)

That's a great app, but I'd like you to add one small addition, for example if you have strike 20 days you'll be able to use 25 cards per day and if you have strike 30 days you'll be able to use 30 cards for day, it'd be interesting and better for users who can't buy a subscription, developers, what do you think about it? I also wanna thank for lovely elephant and such a good cards (you can memorize words absolutely easily), that's an amazing app, best regards, Roman

Duocard is an incredibly useful app for learning languages. One of the best features is the ability to watch YouTube videos that match your language level, which makes learning practical. What I really like is that you can save words to your personal vocabulary list and review them later, making it easy to track your progress. The app helps you focus on the words you're still learning, giving you structure. Subscription is affordable, especially considering how much value it provides.

I really love this app. both the pronunciation and translation and also examples but I wished i could import lots of words at once from word to it. it would have been amazing. also it would have been nice if it could play the words and translation in a row with sound like a recording so that I could listen to it and do other things.

This is a great app. It may not be as 'fun' as Duolingo but I think you will make much more progress with this app. The flash cards are great and even when creating and customising your own flash cards, it's smart enough to add explanations to cards you made and also the listening to your pronunciation seems very good and my girlfriend generally agreed with feedback given as to how I can pronounce better. Reasonable price for the yearly sub as well.

The best app for learning words!! I am so grateful it exists and has so many free options that makes it helpful for everyone! I love the learning experience it offers, I am learning words so fast and on long term, it's easy to add words, app also can explain them, motivate u, learn in a science-based way, not many annoying ads and really It's more than I can ask from a learning language app. The design can be improved but i like that is easy to use. Thank you and keep up the good work!

It's well made app. It can recognize you have something memorized and then after some time it gives you that word back to rehearse. You get plenty of study sources from articles and videos with subtitles from which you can withdraw the word and save it as a card with option to add use of the word in sentence, and it usually also adds cartoon image for given word. Surely it's better to have payed version, especially if you want to study quicky, but I'm happy with free atm for my study pace.

This app is really effective and I got used to using it every day. I love the possibility of adding my own cards or learning from cards of others. I only miss the opportunity to mix all the cards together when I want to practise older ones. I have to wait until they come back naturally. But otherwise really useful tool.
