I don't regret buying it. Thanks to the author. ❤️

Like duolingo but you have way more autonomy over your learning. You can start at whatever level you like, and read articles related to your level of proficiency, watch videos with translations, sing along, and obviously flash cards. It's really great! Lots of ads tho, but expected seeing as it's the free version.

I LOVE this app, it is so good even with free features, and that's why I supported it with a subscription. But one concern is in Japanese cards - sometimes the romanised or hiragana variant of a word does not appear under the word even when that function is enabled. Also, sometimes the pronunciation of a word by the AI voice is completely different from its real pronunciation, especially when dealing with kanji. I suggest Duo cards to work on that. Overall, this app is 100% worth trying! 🤩🤌🏻

Your app is so cool! You have created a very convenient tool for learning languages. DuoCards has the best algorithm for memorising words which helps you learning languages easily. But it started to have one problem you can't correct the words in the cards list as you could do before. Please return this feature back because some language has incorrect translation.

The best flashcard app I've found so far. I just wanted a simple way to create my own flashcard sets and this app has nailed it. You can easily pull cards from other sets too. No more learning useless words that you will never use. Fun and easy (+ cute elephant). Free tier is excellent but the premium version is so cheap you might as well buy it.

The best language learning app period. Very rewarding gameplay and uses a spaced repetition system. I wish it would highlight in green the letters you did get correct when typing in the answer. Currently it only shows green if you get the entire sentence correct. You can type in the answer and there is no multiple choice questions which means it's harder but more effective for learning. I love leveling up the elephant, creating fires and caves. You can even create your own cards! 11/10

This app is absolutely brilliant; flashcards, images, blah blah blah...but even their bugs are helpful. I'm using it to learn Japanese; recently, after an update, i lost all the katakana and hiragana on the cards i was learning. Left with only kanji, everything was much harder...but then i had the idea to go the whole hog, so i turned off images, and doubled down... Today, i passed 1000 cards learned, and I'm so stoked. IMHO, it's better than anki, or any of the competitors...

I've been using this app for years and it's been an incredibly useful tool to me. Everything you want in a language learning SRS. Visual learning, audio learning, spaced recall, it's just incredible. I don't recommend it for languages using Chinese characters because it's not really built to make you recall the pronunciation of your words and sentences. For European languages or any language with an alphabet, abugida or syllabary, it's great.

An excellent app and has helped a lot with my language learning. Good for those who learn better with flashcards and pictures. You can add any new words that you learned elsewhere so you can keep practicing them. Well worth the subscription. I just want there to be grammar sections. DC have added a speaking practice section into it which has helped me with speaking Swedish

Overall, it's probably the best app to expand your vocabulary, as the algorithm is thought-out nicely. The main drawback is that the automatic translation (at least, into Ukrainian) doesn't work well. I have to double-check everything, as sometimes it's either completely incorrect or has a different form, which is also incorrect. Probably, it's linked with Google Translate, which often makes the same mistakes.

I've been loving using this app so far. It's easy to add cards, and I love the options of learning choices it gives you, from articles to videos. I'd have to admit though, it does push u a lot to buy premium, but at least the ads it shows is not a really long unskippable video. It's just self advertisement for the app, and it's really short. That's why I personally brought premium to support the creators.

It's an amazing app and I especially love the autotranslate feature. I saw a negative review with regards to accuracy but I am using this as a complementary learning tool with my language course and I believe this is the intended way of using the app. Could you maybe also add a field for adding gender of words? For example in Slavic languages or French nouns have gender. And one other feature which I would find very useful is correction suggestions, for example "skola" to be "škola".

Great app, very useful for learning vocabulary. It has texts you can read, audio and translation for them, and if you come across a new word you can add it to your card deck. And about the flashcards: I'm glad it doesn't have the annoying features of duolingo (hearts you lose for yor mistakes, too mouch time spent typing the translation). You save time and learn lots of new words fast. If you read them out loud it is even better. The only downside is the ads for the premium version that appear.
Bug: 'Back' gesture (swipe) doesn't work

6 stars ******. this app has all you need and more to learn a language effectively. I was using different apps and all 3 combined did not match this one in effectiveness and flexibility. it adds value in so many different ways. you can copy a word in any other window or app, and send it to (share it to) duocards, cuecards that allow you to revise them until you're fluent in the vocabulary YOU NEED.

You have the ability to upload YouTube videos that include subtitles, and the application will then extract and display the text. With a single click, you can add any unfamiliar words to your learning list. This is an exceptional feature! The DuoCards Team has done a remarkable job! The best app for expanding your vocabulary.

Very versatile flashcard app - using for Italian vocab (recent beginner). Free version understandably imposes limits, but is still v useful. Can add vocab from any source on your device (just highlight and share) as well as from the extensive built-in library of suggested sources, or by manual entry. Keeps recycling vocab until it's come up enough times to be classed as "Learned" (stored in long-term memory) rather than just "Known" (swiped right), and then still occasionally recalls it.

I've tried many many resources lile Duolingo, babbel etc ... But after A2 they become repetitive and inhale but Duocards is just awesome, you can learn from stories, cards, AI will tell you a story, you can highlight a word and share it on Duocards to add it to a card and so much more. It's perfect, even when you add a new word it will translate it, add an image and an example sentence! Just perfect!

This ap is what I was looking for, for a long time! I love the way we can add videos from YouTube and it shows the transcript and goes through it and we can select a word there and add it to the vocabulary. Just, can you please make it somehow that when it is playing a video, and the phone gets locked, it continues to play. At the moment, I have to keep the phone unlocked.

This is the best flashcard app ever. Way better than any other app I've tried, Quizlet, Anki, Lexilize Flashcards... DuoCards is the real deal. I got the premium version a few hours after getting it. Worth every cent. I can't oversell it. It generates sounds and visual clues for you to best remember the words you're trying to learn. It's brilliant!!!! Everything I am expecting from a flashcard app 💯

This is the best flashcards app EVER made!!! I've learned over 300 words and I am really really grateful for this app and for those who created this. It's useful, funny, simple but still with many functions to improve your learning journey, like the power to change the voice that says the words. I just wanna thank you! I recommend this app and for sure its premium version. If you buy it, you won't regret that, because it'll be a good investment!!! ♥️

This is my first review on google play, so this app truly did something exeptionally good. I love that you can add icons to the cards and browse through community sets, get explanations with AI. I have been consistently learning with duocards for over 2year now and it helped me to learn 2 languages at a professional level. The true reason why am writing this review is due to their recent update.. the offline studying option. This is a game changer. Thank you Duocards, best language learning app!

I have been looking for something to help me learn Bulgarian vocabulary for a long time, and got an ad for this. I'm only a few days in, on free version, but absolutely obsessed. there's no judgment for words that need to be repeated on me hundred times 🤣 this is 100% what I needed and I'm likely to buy the premium soon as I'm too upset every day I meet my limit. thank you for this!!

it is a pretty useful app for sure. love that you can make flashcards of whole sentences and it'll clearly speak them to you. They've got a lot of great courses also. Though I do feel it's a bit steep the premium price, when other apps that are similar to this. It's a one off payment which is usually cheaper than what they want for the year.

Really really helpful app for getting you used to the words you struggle with !! I like to use it as extra support for my studies and the way you can add your own words, add them straight from your browser or even from a YouTube video is so handy!! The ads aren't actually annoying either and even if they do annoy you the subscription cost is very worth its value
Much beloved learning assistant, one of the few apps I'm subscribed to.

Really great. I was looking for something exactly like this 👌 I really love the storytelling feature and that you can add words directly from articles. Really great job 👍 looking forward to new features. Just one small problem. One of my friends had a problem with registeration. He got the message that his Email was already registered but he wasn't able to sign in. And he didn't see the forgot-your-password option either.

A subscribe worthy app. All I wish for is a more offline availability. Sometimes, I wanna do it on the train where sometimes cellular can't reach, or on planes. Yet, I love the recent feature of AI assisted explanations. It'd be nice if I don't have to open a modal. I kinda wanna see it all the time if possible. Also, can you add the translation of the example sentences generated by AI in the new AI explanation modal?

Great app for spaced repetition flashcards and for target language content. I would love to see better romanisation in Thai, though. The romanisation is often wrong, and never has tone marks. Please improve this!🙏 It would massively help learners such as my self who are still learning the alphabet. That said, for my other language, spanish, this app is perfect, and has helped me to learn 600+ words in just a couple of months!

I like this app. I'm a B1 in German and I've been trying to find an app that helps me improve my vocabulary. Usually other methods are either too difficult or too boring. Duocards is quite helpful for the level that I'm inas a complementary tool. The price for the family plan is quite convenient too. I would suggest a way for family members to see each other progress to motivate and challenge one another.

Great app. It provides a really working memorization algorithm, and has a really user friendly interface. There are lots of options on how to add a word and modify the proposed translation. I never paid a lot of attention to the progress bar, daily streak and the improving meadow with the elephant, but this greatly works for kids. My son really appreciated this. One question though: how to get to use the teacher's mode? Is it accessible from the same app? Or is it a different tariff plan?

This is a really great app. If you are learning a language for a few months/years and struggle to learn new vocabulary, Duocards is exactly what you need. You can practice you listening and reading skills with videos and articles, and learn vocabulary through your own deck of flashcards. I have used the free version for less than two weeks and I can already see my progress in a language that I have learned for 6 years! The algorithm is perfect and the ads are not disturbing at all. 5/5!

If you're serious about language learning, you have to unfortunately pay. But £25 a year is a bargain. Amazing automated flashcards that prioritise the words you don't know - forget your notebook you havent looked back on in weeks! Great library, including videos with subtitles. Might not be suitable for absolute beginners who need to learn grammar, but there are still lesson courses that will benefit you!

I tried other Tagalog learning apps, but this must be one of the best! I LOVE IT. Here's why: You can add your own words! This is very useful when you only need to learn specific words for school or work It adds more fun! Mostly Learning something is boring but this game made it FUN, Thank You! It's like a game! You know like.. it adds the elephant and flames and whatever, it's like a challenge! It's makes you wanna learn more! And that's fun!

Really well done and rich in high-quality user-created sets of cards for almost every language. Duocards also offers an AI model to train your speaking and whatsoever, which I find amazing. Thanks to AI, Duo Cards is also able to tell you A LOT of information about every word or phrase, including synonyms, common usages and examples, even when the author of the set didn't even write it down. I also recommend the premium package, which doesn't even coat that much.

Firstly, I was using it without regarding other features and was using only base decks. Then I found out that you can literally write your own words, and they will be translated with pictures and example sentences automatically. I really love this! That is what I was looking for!⭐

I've been using this app for almost a year now and it's been perfect, everything you need for spaced repetition is here. The app is really complete, including a good and versatile spaced time for every card you learn, easy to use, the Al system is good and it helps with practice, the explanation for every new word you add is very thoughtful. Anyway, definitely one of the best apps I've seen

I've been using the app for a few months now and I feel like the combination of flashcards, the repeat algorithm and reading them out loud really works for me. Whenever I think of a phrase I don't know how to say, I pick it apart and add cards to my deck, and I think it works better than just writing it down. The AI part is still not too precise or useful but I rather have it then not having it.

Absolutely love this app, there are so many easy ways to learn useful vocabulary everydwy, the only complaint is that some of the words given in the app to learn are a bit easy even at the hardest level but i am still able to translate any word I find and save it in the app to memorize and practice. So far no bugs bur we'll see

I've been renewing my DuoCards annual subscription for 3 years now. The app is irreplaceable and helped improve my English drastically. I recommend DuoCards to anyone who wishes to level up their vocabulary and target language command. Get the foundation of grammar and basic expressions and keep on practicing with cards every day for 20-30 minutes and you won't notice how quickly you'll become Advanced. Good luck!

It's such a wonderful, as well as useful app! Honestly, not only does it make learning and reviewing vocabulary less overwhelming, but also more straightforward. I have to admit, though, that I had my doubts at the beginning, but now I would be more satisfied with it. Certainly, its interactiveness might be what would encourage anyone to go on with their "vocabulary lesson's time"

Oh it does exactly what I wanted, even better than I wanted that. I love the readymade lessons where I can select words and sentences. And I love the way I can add my own words based on my own reading. It suggests the correct translation and even a few sample uses of the word. That so much simplified the process of entering the words!

This is by far the best vocab app I've ever used. There are so many incredibly useful tools, like custom pics for the words, getting vocab out of a text/video/songtext/..., an explanation for every word, AI generated example sentences, an AI chat to ask questions, etc etc. I'm blown away!! Great job to the developer team 🙌

The app is very flexible. You can handwrite the words you want to learn and the system will keep track on how much you remember them or not. The few improvements that could be done is a quicker rotation of the "learned" words. After one year of premium use I'm fully satisfied with the application and I will renew the plan, the new AI storyteller is also very interesting and catchy. Cheers to the duo team

Easy to use & easy to create your own cards. Nice easy quizzes and tests to practice your words/sentences flashcards you add from app library or create yourself.Great little videos you can watch for pratical implication. If i wasn't broke I would pay for the unlimited cards because you can only have 20 unlearned, but on the plus side it forces you to learn to add more. Ads are fine & not too intrusive & you can pay to remove them with a membership. For a free app it goes beyond expectations.

I have started learning English with this app since November 2023. I liked the free app. That's why I decided to get free subscription. Now it ended. I have about а thousand words now and 30🔥 are not enough to me. I don't even repeat words I have. There's nothing to talk about new words... I don't have enough money. And I thank you that you give me opportunity to learn English without buying subscription. I want to learn English that's why I'll have to invite more friends😁 It is the best app!

I use the app for Hungarian which few apps cater for. Most cards are good but its worth running them by a native to make sure they're accurate, not obsolete or uncommon. AI voice doesn't always nail pronunciation. Hard to submit app change requests. But overall, given how there are so few decent apps for Hungarian this is by far my favourite.

This is an excellent application, but it seems to me that repeating after 4 months is not enough to get into the section "learned forever". How about after 4 months do 6/8 months and then 12? I have learned more than 1600 words in a year and it seems to me that I have already forgotten more than half of them. I know that there is a function for manually selecting learned words, but it is inconvenient.
